tools.name: fire_ticket
tools.description: Start cooking a table's ticket. Use when a cook says 'fire 12' or 'fire table 12'.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 12

tools.name: hold_ticket
tools.description: Put a table's ticket on hold. Use for 'hold 9'.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 9

tools.name: bump_ticket
tools.description: Mark a table's ticket finished and remove it from the screen. Use for 'bump 4', '4 is up', '4 out the window'.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 4

tools.name: void_ticket
tools.description: Cancel a table's ticket. Destructive: ask 'Void 7?' first and only call with confirmed=true after the cook says yes.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 7

confirmed.description: true only after the cook explicitly said yes, e.g. true

tools.name: flag_allergy
tools.description: Flag an allergy on a table's ticket. Use for '12 has a nut allergy'.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 12

tools.name: ticket_status
tools.description: Get how long a table's ticket has been open and its status. Use for 'how long on 7', 'where's 7'.

table.description: Table number as an integer, e.g. 7

tools.name: mark_86
tools.description: Set how many portions of a menu item are left. remaining=0 means the item is 86 (sold out). Use for '86 salmon', 'out of salmon', 'two short rib left'.

item.description: Menu item, lowercase, one of the menu names

remaining.description: Portions left as an integer; 0 = sold out. Example: 0

tools.name: restore_item
tools.description: Put a sold-out item back on the menu. Use for 'salmon is back', 'un-86 salmon'.

count.description: Portions now available, e.g. 10. Omit if not said.

tools.name: all_day
tools.description: Total quantity of an item across all open tickets. Use for 'all day fries'.

tools.name: inventory_lookup
tools.description: How many portions of an item are left in stock. Use for 'how many brownies left'.
